executive_summary.title: Executive Summary
executive_summary.content: Recent research into variational quantum algorithms, specifically the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), demonstrates significant potential as well as notable hurdles when applied to constrained portfolio optimization [cite_exec_1]. Standard parameter initializations on 50-asset Markowitz mean-variance problems hit performance ceilings and barren plateau issues at circuit depths beyond p=4 [cite_exec_1]. Conversely, warm-starting strategies involving the warm-start method which initializes rotation angles using continuous relaxations solved via classical interior-point quadratic programming markedly improve approximation ratios and save optimization iterations on larger asset subsets [cite_exec_2, cite_exec_3].

executive_summary.title: Executive Summary
executive_summary.content: Recent research into variational quantum algorithms, specifically the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), demonstrates significant potential as well as notable hurdles when applied to constrained portfolio optimization [cite_exec_1]. Standard parameter initializations on 50-asset Markowitz mean-variance problems hit performance ceilings and barren plateau issues at circuit depths beyond p=4 [cite_exec_1]. Conversely, warm-starting strategies involving the warm-start method which initializes rotation angles using continuous relaxations solved via classical interior-point quadratic programming markedly improve approximation ratios and save optimization iterations on larger asset subsets [cite_exec_2, cite_exec_3].
